groups.reason: Different questions: `/assert` judges an artifact digest against a flow (latest evidence for that digest); `/trails/{trailId}/assert` judges one pipeline run. Neither is a subset of the other.

`/gate/evaluate` applies deployment policies attached to an environment (used by `factstore gate` and the policies tutorial). `/queries/gates/evaluate` evaluates the gate with risk-tier fallback when the server cannot answer (docs/gates.md). Candidate to merge once deployment policies move onto the gate engine.
Three policy models with different inputs: attestation requirement policies, environment deployment policies, and OPA/Rego bundles. Consolidating them is a product decision outside #250.

Real overlap: `/dashboard/stats` and `/metrics/compliance` both return trail compliance totals (metrics adds attestation counts), while `/reports/compliance` breaks the same figures down per flow for auditors. Kept for this release because the web dashboard reads `/dashboard/stats`; next candidate for deprecation once the dashboard reads `/metrics/compliance`.
